About.Title: About
About.Bio: I’m Marcus Amps-Woodward, a sports photographer drawn to the action and the stories around it. Explore my work, or get in touch to talk about your next event.
About.Heading: A feel for the moment.
About.StoryBody: Every sport has a rhythm. The build-up, the burst of effort, the reaction afterwards. Those are the moments I look for—and the ones I want to help you keep.
